data.title: 莲华 · 桧木温泉畔的冷泉小憩
data.description: 月夜下的露天温泉水汽蒸腾。莲华赤足坐在桧木池畔，浅青色的浴衣下摆浸在水面。她用白皙的足尖拨开漂浮的红色枫叶，侧脸在水雾中显得格外清冷脱俗。
data.location: open-air natural hot spring bath surrounded by cypress wood and crimson autumn maples
data.action: sitting on smooth cypress bath ledge with bare feet in steaming water, dipping toes into floating maple leaves with quiet aloof serenity
data.lighting: luminous full moon reflecting on steamy hot spring ripples and red leaves
data.mood: ethereal Japanese quietude, refined timeless grace, breath-stopping cool beauty
data.promptProse: Sitting beside steaming moonlit onsen waters, Renge dips bare toes amidst floating maple leaves, loose yukata baring her graceful neck.
data.animaCaption: Renge dipping bare feet into steaming outdoor onsen waters beneath autumn moonlight.
